new.name: Bumble Bee Wet Fly
new.description: An old wet fly with a banded yellow and black chenille body, light hackle-tip wings and a black hackle, for trout and panfish in summer.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it under overhanging banks or twitch it for bluegill.
steps: Tie in yellow and black chenille together at the bend.
Wrap them forward to make alternating bands.
Tie in a black hackle and wind two turns as a collar.
Tie hackle-tip wings low over the back and finish.

new.name: Blue Rat
new.description: A Rat-series hairwing salmon fly with a peacock sword tail, a royal blue floss and peacock body, a grey fox wing and a grizzly hen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it on a floating line for Atlantic salmon in clear water.
mats: Royal blue floss and peacock herl
steps: Tie a short gold tag and a peacock sword tail.
Wind the rear half in blue floss and the front in peacock herl, then rib with gold.
Tie in a sparse grey fox wing.
Wind a grizzly hen collar and finish an orange head.

new.name: Bluegill Bugger
new.description: A small panfish bugger with brown goose biot tails and a body of brown, black and crystal chenille.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly around docks and brush for bluegill and crappie.
steps: Tie in split biot tails at the bend.
Tie in the chenilles together.
Wrap them forward to form a mottled body.
Whip finish behind the eye.

new.name: Bonefish Special
new.description: Chico Fernandez's classic bonefish fly with an orange marabou tail, a gold tinsel body under clear D-Rib, a white calf tail wing and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in skinny water with short, slow strips.
steps: Tie in an orange marabou tail with a few strands of flash.
Wrap a gold tinsel body and cover it with clear D-Rib.
Tie in a white calf tail wing with a grizzly hackle each side.
Build a neat head and coat it with UV finish.

new.name: Brooks' Stone
new.description: Charles Brooks' heavy stonefly nymph with biot tails, a squirrel blend body, copper rib and grizzly and brown hackles wound through the thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in fast western rivers, especially before the salmonfly hatch.
mats: Brown or black squirrel blend dubbing
steps: Tie in split biot tails and the rib.
Dub a thick, tapered abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the hackles at the thorax.
Spin the thorax dubbing in a loop, wrap it, then wind the hackles through it.

new.name: Conehead Marabou Muddler
new.description: A gold conehead Muddler with a red tail, holographic braid body, yellow marabou wing, peacock over-wing and a natural deer hair collar.
new.fishing_tips: Swing and strip it for trout and smallmouth.
mats: Red duck quill or red schlappen fibres
steps: Slide on the cone and tie in a short red tail.
Wrap the braid body.
Tie in a yellow marabou wing with peacock herl on top.
Spin a deer hair collar behind the cone and trim the butts.

new.name: Cowdung
new.description: A classic winged wet fly with a gold tag, a mixed olive and orange body, a ginger throat and a mottled turkey wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in a team of wets on summer evenings.
mats: Olive and orange rabbit dubbing, mixed
Light brown or ginger hackle fibres
steps: Tie a short gold tag.
Dub a slim body of mixed olive and orange rabbit.
Tie in a throat of ginger fibres.
Tie a mottled turkey wing on top and finish.

new.name: Executioner
new.description: A Scottish salmon fly in Spey style with a crest tail, a red floss and silver body, black hen hackle and a black bucktail and arctic runner wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in dark or peaty water for salmon and sea trout.
steps: Tie the tag and crest tail.
Wind a red floss rear and silver front, then rib it.
Wind a long black hen hackle Spey style.
Tie in a slim black wing, add jungle cock and finish a red head.

new.name: F-Fly
new.description: Marjan Fratnik's simple CDC dry with a natural beaver fur body and a wing of dun CDC, one of the easiest and deadliest small dries.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers during small caddis and mayfly hatches.
mats: Natural dun CDC, two or three feathers
steps: Dub a slim beaver body over the rear two thirds.
Stack two or three CDC feathers together.
Tie them in flat over the body as a wing.
Trim the wing just past the bend and whip finish.

new.name: Female Adams Comparadun
new.description: A comparadun version of the Female Adams with a yellow egg sack, mixed rabbit and mole body and a caribou and brown deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general mayfly dry in slow water.
mats: Coq de Leon and brown fibres
Caribou and brown deer hair, comparadun style
steps: Tie in a fan of deer hair as a comparadun wing.
Tie in the tail and dub a yellow egg sack.
Dub the grey body forward.
Build dubbing in front of the wing to stand it upright.

new.name: Garry Dog
new.description: A classic hairwing salmon fly with a crest tail, a black floss body, blue guinea throat and a wing of red bucktail under yellow squirrel.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in medium water for salmon.
steps: Tie the tag and crest tail.
Wind a black floss body and rib it.
Add a black hackle and blue guinea throat.
Tie a red and yellow hair wing and finish.

new.name: Gold Bead Damsel
new.description: Phil Rowley's simple stillwater damsel with an olive marabou tail and blue flash, an iridescent blue rib, olive hare's ear body, partridge hackle and gold bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near weed beds with a slow hand-twist retrieve.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a marabou tail with two strands of flash.
Tie in the rib and dub a slim body.
Rib the body.
Wind one turn of partridge behind the bead.

new.name: Grizzly Wulff
new.description: A Wulff-style attractor dry with a deer hair tail and wing, a yellow floss body and mixed brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in fast water where a high floater is needed.
steps: Tie in and divide an upright deer hair wing.
Tie in a deer hair tail.
Wind a smooth yellow floss body.
Wind brown and grizzly hackles behind and in front of the wing.

new.name: Halo Mayfly Emerger
new.description: A mayfly emerger with a sparkle yarn tag, a marabou tail, a fluorescent orange deer hair spike, a white foam wing and a Simi Seal body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film when fish ignore duns.
steps: Tie in the marabou tail and yarn tag.
Dub the Simi Seal body.
Tie in a foam wing on each side as a halo.
Add a short orange deer hair spike on top.

new.name: Hi-Vis Parachute Mayfly
new.description: A parachute mayfly with a white Aerodry wing post, a golden yellow and chocolate dubbed body and a pink hi-vis hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in broken light where a dark parachute disappears.
mats: Golden yellow and chocolate brown dubbing
steps: Tie in a white post.
Dub a slim yellow abdomen.
Dub a darker thorax around the post.
Wind the pink hackle around the post and finish.

new.name: Keel Crab
new.description: A permit crab built with a mono keel and beads so it lands right and dives, with a ginger marabou tail, grizzly claws, gold dumbbell eyes and EP crab eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Cast ahead of tailing permit and let it sink.
steps: Tie on the dumbbell eyes and the crab eyes.
Tie in the marabou tail and grizzly claws.
Thread beads on the mono and tie it in as a keel under the hook.
Build the body and finish.

new.name: Last Chance Cripple
new.description: Rene Harrop's crippled mayfly with a wood duck tail, a dubbed shuck, a turkey biot body, a CDC wing and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to selective trout on flat water.
steps: Tie in a wood duck tail and dub a short shuck.
Wrap a biot body and glue it.
Tie in a CDC wing.
Dub the thorax and wind a sparse hackle.

new.name: McGinty
new.description: The McGinty bucktail with a red tail, a yellow, black and yellow banded chenille body, a brown hackle and a squirrel tail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout, steelhead and panfish.
steps: Tie in a red tail.
Wrap three bands of chenille.
Wind a brown hackle.
Tie in the squirrel wing and finish.

new.name: Mole Fly
new.description: A tiny emerger or midge with a brown beaver body and a wing of white fluoro fibre and dun CDC.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film for picky trout.
mats: 3 strands white fluoro fibre and 2 dun CDC
steps: Dub a small beaver body around the bend.
Tie in white fluoro fibre and CDC together as a wing.
Trim the wing short.
Dub a little in front of the wing and finish.

new.name: Olive Damsel Nymph
new.description: A slim damsel nymph with mono eyes, an olive marabou tail, a stretch nylon rib, superfine body, SLF Prism thorax and a Swiss straw back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near weeds on a slow retrieve.
steps: Tie in the mono eyes.
Tie in the marabou tail and rib.
Dub the body and rib it.
Dub the thorax and pull the straw back over it.

new.name: Parachute Emerger
new.description: A parachute emerger with an Antron shuck, an olive brown body, a white foam post, a grey beaver thorax and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during BWO and PMD hatches.
steps: Tie in the Antron shuck.
Dub the body around the bend.
Tie in a foam post and dub the thorax.
Wind the hackle around the post.

new.name: Parmachene Belle
new.description: A classic Maine wet fly with a silver body, a red and white tail and hackle and a married white, red and white wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout in lakes and ponds.
mats: White hen and red cock or hen
White, red and white duck quills, married
steps: Tie the tag, tail and ostrich butt.
Wind the body and rib it.
Wind red and white hackles.
Marry the wing slips and tie them on top.

new.name: Pistol Pete
new.description: A small propeller-head fly for bass, panfish and trout, with a red tail, a yellow chenille body ribbed with black, and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Retrieve it steadily so the propeller spins.
steps: Slide on the propeller and bead.
Tie in the red tail and rib.
Wrap the chenille and rib it.
Wind the hackle behind the bead.

new.name: Platte River Special
new.description: A classic western streamer with a tubing body, a red throat and a wing of yellow and brown streamer hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout in big western rivers.
mats: Gold, orange or yellow tubing over mylar tinsel
Two yellow and two brown streamer hackles
steps: Wrap a tinsel underbody and cover it with tubing.
Tie in a red throat.
Tie in yellow hackles flat on each side.
Add brown hackles over the top and finish.

new.name: Professor
new.description: A traditional wet fly with a red tail, a yellow floss body ribbed with silver, a ginger hackle and a mallard flank wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
steps: Tie in the red tail.
Wind yellow floss and rib it.
Add the hackle.
Tie the mallard wing and finish in black.

new.name: Queen of the Waters
new.description: A Bergman-era wet fly with an orange floss body, palmered brown hen and a teal or mallard wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout and panfish.
steps: Wind a smooth orange floss body.
Palmer a brown hen hackle through it.
Tie in a teal or mallard wing.
Finish the head.

new.name: Sheep Fly
new.description: An Appalachian nymph with a brown tail, a buggy muskrat body, a brown hackle and grizzly hackle-tip wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in mountain streams.
steps: Add weight and tie in a brown tail.
Dub a buggy muskrat body.
Wind a brown hackle.
Tie grizzly hackle-tip wings on top and finish.

new.name: Silver Wilkinson
new.description: A hairwing version of the Silver Wilkinson with an orange bucktail tail, a silver body and magenta and light blue hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for salmon in bright water.
mats: Orange bucktail and pearl Krystal Flash
steps: Tie the silver tag and an orange bucktail and flash tail.
Wind a silver body and rib it.
Wind magenta then light blue hackles at the front.
Add jungle cock cheeks and finish.

new.name: Tellico Nymph
new.description: A vintage nymph from Tennessee with a mallard tail, a yellow floss body under a turkey shell, a peacock and copper rib and a brown hen collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in mountain streams.
steps: Tie in a short mallard tail and a strip of turkey for the shell.
Wind a yellow floss body.
Pull the turkey over the back and rib it with peacock herl and copper wire.
Wind a brown hen collar and finish.

new.name: Thunderhead
new.description: A Wulff-style Appalachian dry with a deer hair tail, grey body, white calf wing and brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in pocket water.
steps: Tie in and divide a white calf tail wing.
Tie in a deer hair tail.
Dub a grey body.
Wind a brown hackle behind and in front of the wing.

new.name: Posh Tosh
new.description: A bright chartreuse Tosh variant with a holographic body, chartreuse hackle and bucktail, a black arctic runner wing and jungle cock.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in coloured water for salmon.
mats: Chartreuse holographic and opal mirage tinsel
Chartreuse bucktail and pearl Krystal Flash
steps: Wind the two-tinsel body and rib it with chartreuse wire.
Wind a chartreuse hackle as a collar.
Tie in chartreuse bucktail and flash, then a black wing over it.
Add jungle cock eyes and finish.

new.name: White Marabou Muddler
new.description: A white marabou muddler with a calf tail tail, SLF body, grizzle cock and marabou wing and a deer hair head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and pike.
mats: Grizzle cock, micro Flashabou, white and black marabou
steps: Tie in a white calf tail and the rib.
Dub an SLF body and rib it, with a gill-coloured throat.
Tie in a wing of grizzle cock, micro flash and white then black marabou.
Spin a deer hair head and trim it to shape.

new.name: Yellow Palmer
new.description: An old palmered dry with a yellow body and brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in fast water.
steps: Tie in a tail of mixed brown and grizzly fibres.
Tie in the brown and grizzly hackles at the bend.
Dub a yellow body forward.
Palmer both hackles through the body and tie off.

new.name: Zuddler
new.description: A cone head sculpin of rabbit tail, Ice Dub body, rubber legs, red gills and a deer hair collar.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it near the bottom.
steps: Slide on the cone and tie in a rabbit strip tail.
Dub an Ice Dub body.
Tie in rubber legs and red flash gills at the front.
Spin a deer hair collar behind the cone.

new.name: Thunder Creek Minnow
new.description: Keith Fulsher's reverse-tied bucktail minnow with a dark back, white belly, painted eyes and a lacquered head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Wrap a silver tinsel body.
Tie white bucktail under and brown bucktail on top, both pointing forward over the eye.
Fold the hair back and tie it down to form a bullet head, keeping the colours separate.
Paint eyes on the head and coat it with cement or epoxy.

new.name: Black Bear Green Butt
new.description: A simple salmon and steelhead fly with a fluorescent green butt, black body, silver rib and black bear wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in low water.
steps: Tie a short silver tag and a fluorescent green butt.
Wind a slim black body.
Rib it with oval silver tinsel.
Tie in a sparse black bear wing and finish.

new.name: Silver Rat
new.description: A Rat-series fly with a crest tail, a silver body, a grey fox wing and a grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in clear water.
steps: Tie a gold tag and a crest tail.
Wind a silver body and rib it with gold.
Tie in a grey fox wing.
Wind a grizzly hackle collar and finish a red head.

new.name: Montreal
new.description: A classic wet fly with a claret body, gold rib, claret hackle and a turkey wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout.
steps: Tie in a claret tail.
Wind a claret body and rib it with gold.
Tie in a claret hackle as a beard.
Tie a mottled turkey wing on top.

new.name: Brad's Brat
new.description: A Northwest steelhead fly with an orange and white wing over a two-tone orange and red body.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for summer and winter steelhead.
steps: Tie in an orange and white bucktail tail.
Wind an orange rear and red front body and rib it with gold.
Wind a brown hackle.
Tie a white under orange bucktail wing.

new.name: Boss
new.description: A California steelhead fly with bead chain eyes, a black chenille body and a fluorescent orange hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it near the bottom.
steps: Tie on bead chain eyes behind the hook eye.
Tie in a black calf tail tail.
Wrap a black chenille body and rib it with silver.
Wind an orange hackle behind the eyes.

new.name: Max Canyon
new.description: A summer steelhead fly with an orange and black body, a brown hackle and a white over orange wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for summer steelhead.
mats: Orange under white calf or bucktail
steps: Tie in an orange and white tail.
Wind an orange rear and black front body and rib it.
Wind a black hackle.
Tie a white over orange wing.

new.name: Butterfly
new.description: A low-water salmon fly with a red tail, peacock body, white goat wings in a V and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in low, clear water.
steps: Tie in a red tail.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Tie in white goat hair and split it into a V.
Wind a brown hackle collar.

new.name: Adams Wulff
new.description: A Wulff-style Adams with a moose tail, grey body, calf wings and brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in pocket water.
steps: Tie in and divide a white calf tail wing.
Tie in a moose hair tail.
Dub a grey body.
Wind brown and grizzly hackles together.
